title: Dijital Varlık Transfer ve Muhasebe Uygulama Geliştirme Müdürü
description: Yapı Kredi olarak 1944’ten beri ilklerin, yeniliklerin ve kültür sanatın bankasıyız. Finans sektörünün tartışmasız lideri olma vizyonuyla yolumuzda ilerliyor, her adımımızda paydaşlarımıza ve ülkemize değer katıyoruz. Bugünü olduğu kadar geleceği de önemsiyor, sürdürülebilirliği iş kültürümüzün merkezine yerleştiriyoruz. Sen de bugüne ve geleceğe değer katan, yenilikçi fikirlerin peşinden giden, gücünü birbirinden alan bir ekibin parçası olmak istersen hemen aramıza katıl. Dijital Varlık ekibimizde görev alacak Dijital Varlık Transfer ve Muhasebe Uygulama Geliştirme Müdürü arıyoruz! Bu rol için aradığımız nitelikler neler? Üniversitelerin tercihen Mühendislik, İstatistik veya Matematik Fakültelerinden mezun Blok zincir teknolojilerine hakim, kripto borsalarında en az 1 yıl deneyimli ve proje tecrübesi bulunan, En az 5 yıl alanında deneyimli, İleri seviyede İngilizce bilen, Güçlü iletişim ve raporlama becerileri olan, Dijital Varlık Transfer ve Muhasebe Uygulama Geliştirme Müdürü sorumlulukları neler? Sorumlu olduğu ürün ve uygulamaların kesintisiz ve müşteri memnuniyetini en üst seviyede tutacak şekilde gelişimini sağlamak. Yapı Kredi Teknoloji ekipleri ile koordineli bir şekilde çalışmak ve yeni standartlara uyum sağlamak. Yapı Kredi Teknoloji’nin verdiği proje yönetimi, altyapı ve güvenlik hizmetlerinin kendi sorumluluk alanına giren kısımları için koordinasyonu sağlamak. Ekibinde yer alan kişilerin uygulama geliştirmesi için görev tanımlarında yer alan çalışmaları zamanında ve kaliteli yapmalarını sağlamak Yazılım Geliştirme Metodolojisinde (SDLC) tariflenen sorumlulukları yerine getirebilmek için kaynak planlaması yapmak Sorumlusu olduğu alanlarda yapılan çalışmalar için analiz ve tasarımları kontrol etmek, gerekli durumlarda danışmanlık vermek Sorumlu olduğu alanlarla ilgili karşılaşılan problemleri gidermek, tekrarlanmaması için gerekli koruyucu önlemleri almak Sistem izlemek için gerekli yapıların kurulmasını sağlamak ve olası sorunların oluşmasını engelleyici aksiyonları almak Sorumlu olduğu alanlar için yapılan çalışmalarda banka tarafından belirlenmiş metodoloji, prosedür ve süreçlerin uygulanmasını sağlamak Sorumlu olduğu alanlar için sistem vizyonunu oluşturmak ve bu vizyona gitmek için iş planlarının oluşturulması için ilgili iş kolları, mimari ekipler, altyapı ekipleri ve Süreç ve Program Yönetimi ile çalışmak Sorumlusu olduğu sistemlerin kullanıcıları, beraber çalıştığı diğer Teknoloji ekipleri, Proje ve Süreç Yönetimi ile iletişimi yönetmek, sonuç odaklı bir şekilde koordinasyon sağlamak ve sinerji oluşturmak Teknoloji'yi takip ederek, sorumlusu olduğu alanlarda oluşacak ihtiyaçlar doğrultusunda gerek görülen teknolojinin banka standartlarında yer aldığı şekilde kullanılmasını sağlamak Kripto varlık platformu mobil uygulamalarının uçtan uca uygulama geliştirme süreçlerini yönetmek, koordine etmek ve kaynak planlamasını yapmak Kripto ürünleri için kısa, orta ve uzun vadeli geliştirme roadmapleri oluşturmak ve iş önceliklendirmesini yönetmek Geliştirme süreçlerinde ölçülebilir performans ve kalite metrikleri tanımlamak ve takip etmek Yapı Kredili olmak sana neler katacak? 📖 Yapı Kredi Akademi ile sınırsız gelişim, 🏆Fark yaratan başarıların ödüllendireceği takdir ve ödüllendirme uygulamaları, 🔄Yapı Kredi ve Koç Grubu içinde kariyer, gelişim ve rotasyon fırsatları, ⚕️Özel sağlık ve hayat sigortası, 🍝TokenFlex dijital yemek kartı, ✨Sosyal destek ödemeleri, 🐾Yapı Kredi Gönüllüleri ile dâhil olabileceğin sosyal sorumluluk projeleri, 🏀16 farklı spor dalında faaliyet gösteren Yapı Kredi Spor Kulübü, 🎭Yapı Kredililerin sosyal kulübü BizClub ile birçok kültür-sanat etkinliğine indirimli bilet alma fırsatı, 🎁Özel günler için hediye kitleri, 🎂Doğum günü izni, 🐏Koç Ailem, Koç Akademi, Koç Healthcare eşliğinde Koçlu olmanın ayrıcalıklı dünyası, …ve çok daha fazlası! Eğer sen de bu dünyanın bir parçası olmak istiyorsan, hemen başvurunu yap ve Yapı Kredili olma yolunda ilk adımını at! Geleceğe yön vermek #YapımızdaVar . * Yapı Kredi’de işe alım sürecimiz tüm pozisyonlar için İK görüşmesi, yönetici görüşmeleri ve yetkinlik değerlendirme envanterleri içerir. Bütün aşamaları başarıyla tamamlaman durumunda teklif aşamasına geçilir. “6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu kapsamında kişisel verilerinizin işlenmesinden doğan haklarınıza ve bu konudaki detaylı bilgiyehttps://kariyerim.yapikredi.com.tr/Account/StaticKvkk adresinde yer alan aydınlatma metnimizden ulaşabilirsiniz.”

title: Linux Software Engineer - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon (multiple roles and seniority levels)
description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Canonical’s Partner Engineering Team is looking for open-source enthusiasts to work across the full Linux stack to ensure new silicon technologies, such as new hardware accelerators, AI stacks, confidential computing, networking, virtualization, and containerization stacks, are optimized for new silicons. Partner Engineering works closely with worldwide silicon companies to optimize Ubuntu for their new silicon, from x86, ARM, RISC-V, PowerPC and s390x architectures. Location: This is a Globally remote role The role entails Collaborating proactively within a distributed team Fostering a software ecosystem with seamless user experience for all Ubuntu users Evaluating contributions of other engineers to maintain high-quality software standards. Playing a role in shaping the future of Ubuntu via both - new ideas in your areas of interest and advising on work being done elsewhere Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu and Debian communities, with upstream projects, and commercially supported customers Debugging issues on open source code and team maintained code. Helping our our customers to integrate their apps, SDKs, build OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server Working with a team to maintain Ubuntu, silicon features, and silicon-optimized packages across platforms and technologies such as: Servers, HPC and AI systems, IoT devices, PCs, SmartNICs and automotive systems AI stacks Graphics, audio and multimedia stacks Virtualisation and Containers Hardware enablement stacks New architectures, architecture variants and optimized toolchains Package management and dependencies Platform security (secure boot, FDE, Ubuntu Core, Confidential Computing) Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal events What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path You love technology and working with brilliant people You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated You value building partnerships with a diverse set of internal and external groups Strong fundamentals in C, C++ and Python Experience or interest in learning Linux distribution packaging Experience or Interest in open source maintenance or contribution and licenses Fundamental understanding of package management and dependency resolution Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring Experience with one or more of the following: Graphics, audio, or multimedia stacks Virtualization and containers (Docker, OCI, Kubernetes) Hardware enablement for platforms and devices, including SmartNICs, NVMe storage, GPUs, audio components, and sensors Performance optimization Toolchain development and maintenance Networking protocols and technologies (TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST) Security best practices IoT and embedded systems, including board-level hardware, SoCs, BMCs, bootloaders, firmware, operating systems, applications, and services What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Integration Engineer, Quark (Remote) - $15,000/year USD
description: You build working customer solutions, not isolated features that may never reach a user. You like the hard middle: vague requirements, messy APIs, structured content, authentication flows, migration scripts, and the moment a customer can finally run their workflow end to end. If you want neatly scoped tickets with little customer contact, this is not the right fit. Quark helps enterprise teams manage complex content workflows. In this role, you will turn customer needs into reliable implementations on the Quark platform: configurations, REST API integrations, webhooks, SSO/SAML connections, XML/XSLT transforms, migrations, and workflow automations. The work is technical, customer-facing, and outcome-based. A good demo is not enough. The solution must work in real conditions, be tested against acceptance criteria, and be clear enough for others to support. AI is part of how the work gets done. You will use tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster, and you will build practical AI agents, Skill files, or similar automation assets that reduce repeat work. Over time, your impact grows from delivering single implementations to creating reusable delivery patterns that make future customer rollouts faster and more reliable. If you want hands-on integration work where AI, structured content, and customer value meet, apply now. What You Will Be Doing Turn customer requirements into technical implementation plans, acceptance criteria, and delivery tasks Configure Quark workflows, structured content models, rules, integrations, and external data-source connections Build and test REST API, webhook, SSO/SAML, XML/XSLT, migration, and scripting-based automation deliverables Diagnose implementation defects by analyzing logs, payloads, authentication flows, transforms, and configuration dependencies Create concise runbooks, handover materials, and walkthroughs that help customers operate the delivered solution What You Won’t Be Doing Building unrelated core product features with no direct customer implementation goal Working from vague tickets without clarifying requirements, constraints, and acceptance criteria Applying temporary workarounds without root-cause analysis, validation, and reusable documentation Handing off generic training decks that leave customers dependent on undocumented tribal knowledge Waiting weeks to perfect a solution before showing tested working progress Integration Engineer Key Responsibilities Deliver reliable Quark customer implementations that connect systems, content workflows, and users to measurable customer value. Basic Requirements At least 3 years of hands-on software engineering, systems integration, implementation, or technical consulting experience Experience building or troubleshooting REST API and webhook integrations Working knowledge of authentication concepts such as SSO or SAML Practical proficiency with XML and XSLT or an equivalent structured-data transformation technology Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language used for migration, automation, or workflow implementation Regular practical use of AI developer tools such as Claude Code or Cursor Experience building at least one useful AI agent, Skill file, agent definition, or equivalent automation artifact Fluent in written and spoken English for customer discovery, requirements clarification, and technical handover Availability for at least 4 hours per day overlapping with business hours for US customers and 4 hours for Europe. Nice-to-have Requirements Experience with content management, publishing platforms, or structured content workflows Experience creating customer-facing technical documentation, runbooks, or implementation handover materials Experience converting ambiguous customer requirements into end-to-end integrations, migrations, or workflow automations About Quark Quark was founded in 1981 and is a pioneer and expert in graphic design, digital publishing and content automation. QuarkXPress has more than 50,000 users worldwide, and 100+ enterprise customers use our Quark Publishing Platform software to inform, educate and entertain their target audiences. Quark has been awarded with Great Place To Work Certification™, which recognizes employers that creating an outstanding experience for their employees. Certification is based on employee feedback gathered by Great Place To Work® – the global authority on workplace culture. Working with us Crossover is a private recruiter for ESW Capital’s portfolio of global enterprise software companies and AI-first organizations, hiring top talent from around the world. These companies are building the future of software, data, AI, product, education, finance, and operations, without location-based pay or outdated hiring rituals. They’re transparent, metrics-based, and known for their work-life balance. As their recruiter, we use skills-based, science-backed hiring to help them find the top 1% of talent no matter where they live. We’re talking software engineers, AI specialists, product leaders, marketers, analysts, and operators - tech people who excel in autonomous, high-performance, remote-first environments. Roles are fully remote, long-term positions, working with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and beyond. This is a full-time role requiring 40 hours per week that you can start immediately. You’ll work as an independent contractor through Crossover, with weekly payments and clear expectations from day one. The pay for this role is $7 USD per hour, which amounts to $15,000 USD per year, based on 40 hours per week over 50 weeks. For full details, visit: www.crossover.com/job-roles Crossover Job Code: LJ-5837-TR-COUNTRY-IntegrationEng
